description.p: Frameguin exposes the Framework laptop hardware controls that the kernel does not: the battery charge limit, keyboard backlight, fingerprint reader LED brightness, and haptic touchpad feedback. Every control is also reachable from a tray icon, so the common adjustments need no window.

Controls appear only for the hardware the board reports, so a machine shows exactly what it can actually change. Changing a setting is authorized through polkit; on non-Framework hardware the app opens and reports that it found none.
